name: Hayashi Konoha
source:
Another member of class 2-B.
Konoha is a member of the school's Library committee.
She is a susceptible girl who fell in love with [url=/c1829]Sakimori Motoko[/url], her senpai whom she longs for. Konoha is always worrying if senpai loves her or not. She lovingly wears the amulet that she got from her senpai.
